Collection by Distress, Suit, Lien, Etc

law.catch_line: Assessment not invalid unless rights prejudiced by error
law.text: No assessment of property, other than real property, shall be invalid because of any error, omission or irregularity by the commissioner of the revenue or other assessing officer in charging such property in the personal property or other tax book, unless it is shown by the person contesting any such assessment that such error, omission or irregularity has operated to prejudice his rights.
